In `_client.py`, when a span exists, `sentry_patched_make_api_call` catches `BaseException` from `orig_make_api_call`, calls `_finish_span(span, error)`, and returns `{}` instead of re-raising. Thus a failing boto3 client call can suppress botocore’s exception entirely, so the caller does not receive the original exception object.
